title: Microsoft Purview role groups: who can run which compliance and data governance tasks?
summary: Hold: the page incorrectly says administrative units are populated in Microsoft Entra rather than Purview without limiting that statement to directory resources. Microsoft documents associating SharePoint sites with administrative units in the Purview portal; the sentence should be narrowed to users and groups. The documented role-group controls, expiry limits and licensing requirements otherwise check out, with two minor qualifications.

claims.where: controls[0].ui
claims.claim: Membership is managed in Microsoft Purview portal at Settings > Roles and scopes > Role groups > Role groups for Microsoft Purview solutions > role group > Edit > Edit members of the role group > Choose users or Choose groups.
claims.quote: Go to Settings > Roles and scopes ... Select Role groups. On Role groups for Microsoft Purview solutions, select a Microsoft Purview role group ... Select Edit on the control bar. On Edit members of the role group, select Choose users or Choose groups.

claims.claim: Organization Management membership is managed at Settings > Roles and scopes > Role groups > Role groups for Microsoft Purview solutions > Organization Management > Edit > Edit members of the role group > Choose users.
claims.quote: Role Management ... assigned only to the Organization Management role group ... On Role groups for Microsoft Purview solutions, select a Microsoft Purview role group ... Select Edit ... On Edit members of the role group, select Choose users or Choose groups.

claims.claim: Add-RoleGroupMember -Identity "Organization Management" -Member <user> adds the user to Organization Management.
claims.quote: Use the Add-RoleGroupMember cmdlet to add members to a management role group. ... The Identity parameter specifies the role group to add a member to. If the role group name contains spaces, enclose the name in quotation marks (").

claims.quote: On Role groups for Microsoft Purview solutions, select Create role group. ... On Name the role group, enter a name for the custom role group in the Name field. ... On Add roles to the role group, select Choose roles.
claims.fix: Include the intervening wizard page: 'Settings > Roles and scopes > Role groups > Role groups for Microsoft Purview solutions > Create role group > Name the role group > Add roles to the role group > Choose roles', as documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/purview-permissions.

claims.where: controls[3].api
claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented PowerShell or API automation for expiry on Purview role-group assignments.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview role group assignment expiration PowerShell API Set-RoleGroup Add-RoleGroupMember expiration; "Purview" "role group" "expiration" "Graph" API. Read purview-permissions and Add-RoleGroupMember/Set-RoleGroup references; no expiry operation found.

claims.where: controls[4].api
claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented PowerShell or API automation for assigning administrative-unit scope to Purview role-group members.

Read purview-admin-units, purview-permissions and Set-RoleGroup; results document Entra assignments, not this operation.

claims.where: controls[5].ui and controls[5].api
claims.claim: No UI or API control is documented for just-in-time activation of direct user assignments to Purview role groups.
